scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:native && npm run test:wasm
scripts.test:native: mkdir -p .cache && cc -O2 -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -DSIEVE_TEST_HOOKS -o .cache/sieve_test tests/native/sieve_test.c wasm/sieve.c wasm/bignum.c -lm && .cache/sieve_test && cc -O2 -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -o .cache/bignum_test tests/native/bignum_test.c wasm/bignum.c -lm && .cache/bignum_test
scripts.test:wasm: mkdir -p .cache && emcc tests/wasm/bignum_harness.c wasm/bignum.c -O2 --no-entry -sSTANDALONE_WASM -sALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH -sEXPORTED_FUNCTIONS=_harness_first_input,_harness_second_input,_harness_output,_harness_compare,_harness_add_small,_harness_subtract_small,_harness_mod_small,_harness_square_root_upper,_harness_bit_length -o .cache/bignum_harness.wasm && emcc wasm/sieve.c wasm/bignum.c -O2 --no-entry -sSTANDALONE_WASM -sALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH -sWASM_BIGINT -sINITIAL_MEMORY=4MB -sMAXIMUM_MEMORY=16MB -sEXPORTED_FUNCTIONS=_request_buffer,_sieve_next,_sieve_prev,_batch_base_limbs,_batch_base_limb_count,_batch_offset_buffer,_batch_reached_memory_limit,_base_prime_limit,_extend_base_primes,_set_base_prime_memory_budget,_reserve_base_prime_storage,_base_prime_memory_bytes -o .cache/sieve_small_memory.wasm && node --test 'tests/wasm/*.test.ts'
